senses.gloss: ch. same, to be shaded, to lie down, sleep.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:21">Targ. Job XL, 21</cite>.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXIV, 13. Targ. II Esth. I, 4 מיגני to recline for meals, to dine; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 65a:15">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite> did not allow his daughters <he>גַּנְיָאן גבי הדדי</he> (Ms. M. <he>דגַנְיָין</he>) to sleep together.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:18">Ib. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִיגְנֵי וכ׳</he> let him lie in the sun.
<cite ref="Yoma 78b:6">Yoma 78ᵇ</cite> <he>וליגני</he> and let him sleep (in his sandals).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:6">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>גְּנִי אפוריא</he> lie down on the bed. Y. Taan. I, end, 64ᵇ <he>כותלא דגְנָאֵי ביה</he> a wall of a room in which people sleep; ib. IV, 64ᵈ bot. <he>דגַנְיֵי</he>.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>גָּנֵי</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="C00028"><he>גָּאנֵי</he></cite>) is lying. [<cite ref="Berakhot 59a">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="C01129"><he>גְּנַח</he> I</cite>.]
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 4:5">Targ. Is. IV, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:15">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 15</cite>.

senses.gloss: to cause to lie down. Targ. II Esth. I, 3 (2) וא׳ וכ׳ and made them lie down (for meals),—Snh. l. c. they had a bed דהוו מַגְנֵי עלה וכ׳ upon which they made strangers lie.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite>; Tanḥ. Korah 10 <he>ואַגְנִיתֵיה וכ׳</he> and made him lie down on his bed; Snh. l. c.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>אַגְנַיִין בעיליתאי</he> hide me, I pray, in my room (v. Rashi a. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>אגניתיה בעיליתיה</he> I kept his body in his room.

senses.gloss: (v. preced. Hithpa.) to be disgraced, become repulsive.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 15:16">Targ. II Chr. XV, 16</cite>.—Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ bot. [read:] <he>דלא יהוון מִיתְגַּנִּין בי</he> that they may not be disgraced through me (be ashamed of me).
<cite ref="Shabbat 140b:14">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>ואתי למִגַּנְיָא</he> and he may be disgraced.
<cite ref="Shabbat 65a:9">Ib. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>מידי דמִיגַּנְיָא ביה</he> something by which she is exposed.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65b:4">Keth. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּתְגַּנִּי ותִתְגַּ׳</he> let her look repulsive (her husband being dead).
